_meta.purpose: UNIRA migration/displacement parameters. 'verified' = number quoted in fetched source text (see evidence.csv). 'assumption' = analyst estimate, not a sourced fact.

new_conflict_persecution_displacement_st.note: 0 only if 'no wars/persecution' fully holds; range allows residual communal/criminal violence

share_of_existing_forced_stock_returning.note: Mozambique suggests near-complete return within ~3 yrs; protracted (70%) caseloads and children born abroad lower it; rest integrate locally

disaster_displacement_m_per_yr.type: assumption anchored on verified 24 m avg / 45.8 m in 2024
disaster_displacement_m_per_yr.note: Not removed by peace or income; DRR shortens duration rather than eliminating evacuations

climate_internal_migrants_2050_m.note: Best-case floor with strong mitigation + inclusive development

intl_migrant_share_after_convergence.note: Clemens: rich-country emigration prevalence ~ similar to poorest (~4%); current global stock 3.6-3.7%. Convergence changes motives more than volume

transitional_emigration_uplift_while_poo.note: +0.35 per 100% GDP/cap rise below PPP$10k (to all destinations); +0.74 to rich destinations
